papers.headline: Floruit c. 480–530 (Luoyang 516–526, dead before 534); the famous 527 arrival fails three independent tests; his teacher Prajñātāra is first attested in 801, a lineage seam insertion; no Indian source attests the name Bodhidharma at all.
papers.title: Who was Bodhidharma? A dated-witness stratigraphy and lineage-chart forensics

papers.headline: Caraka and Suśruta were translated in Baghdad (Suśruta 786–803; Caraka quoted by c. 850) and never in China; Vāgbhaṭa corroborated at c. 550–650 by Yijing's 691 report; the '5,000-year-old Ayurveda' claim conflates three layers and overshoots the canon by ~2,800 years.
papers.title: The canon travelled west: dating the Ayurvedic saṃhitās against the Baghdad, Chinese and Tibetan records

papers.headline: The 629 CE foundation date is the youngest layer of the tradition, contradicted by its own earliest texts (which land in the 9th century); the attestation ladder runs 782/783 (tombstone, AH 166) → 849 (Quilon plates, firm) → 1124 (first dated mosque foundation in Kerala).
papers.title: An attestation ladder for India's first mosque: the Cheraman tradition against the dated record

papers.headline: Gospel of Thomas composed c. 70–140 (forced by the papyri); the Northwest/Gondophares strand is plausible–unproven (the Acts names the king and his brother, attested nowhere in Greek or Roman literature); the Malabar itinerary is first written in the 16th century; the Chinese record attests the carrier (635/638/781) and never names Thomas — no bite on the man.
papers.title: Thomas in the East: the Gospel of Thomas, the Gondophares strand, and the limits of the Chinese record

papers.headline: REGISTERED NEGATIVE: the pre-registered blind gates failed — absolute gate 0/17 against a bar of ≥15, ordering gate Kendall τ = 0.000 with 15 inversions. No date for the Bṛhadāraṇyaka was produced; the sampler was exonerated and the single-branch model class falsified (register impersonates date). A successor requires a background/register branch under a NEW registration.
papers.title: Dating the Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad by a linguistic clock: a pre-registered blind-gate failure

papers.headline: Same brains scanned in vivo and ex vivo (Brain/MINDS, n = 30 pairs): hippocampal formation −21.0% after perfusion fixation (30/30 pairs negative); total labelled gray matter −10.4%; both pre-registered thresholds crossed.
papers.title: One Brain, Two Rulers: The Hippocampal Formation Measures 21% Smaller After Perfusion Fixation in the Same Marmoset Brains

papers.headline: Endocast occupancy joined for 42 species: median 0.919; only 40.5% within the 90–100% band fossil EQ assumes; 19.0% above 100% (ruler mismatch); Artiodactyla 0.79, Cetacea 0.79, Perissodactyla 0.84; Dembitzer supplement back-calculates ECV = brain × 1.108 for 149 species.
papers.title: The Brain Does Not Fill the Skull: A 42-Species Occupancy Audit Finds Ruler Chaos, Not a Constant

tools.description: The Correlation Web's instrument: a queryable database of foreign dated records (Chinese colophons, catalogues, pilgrim records, annals; Arabic and epigraphic records) constraining Indian dates, with a reign-era→CE converter (106 era entries), a measured composition-to-translation lag model (n=5 solid cases, median 186 years, stamped PROVISIONAL), and a circularity guard. 133 anchors. MIT (code).
